claims.evidence: Those tests can locate what YouTube calls “outlier videos”: exceptional performers that can inspire future uploads. New Insights and Research data in YouTube Studio can add more context to those outliers, and the same philosophy is being applied to thumbnails, too. After bringing dynamic insertion to its ads at last year’s Made On event, YouTube is now introducing dynamic thumbnails. By automatically switching between multiple preview images, YouTube is aiming to maximize reach among specific audience segments. If you’ve tuned into previous editions of YouTube’s product spiel, the headlines for the 2026 presentation may sound familiar. Those experiments already allow creators to pit multiple titles and thumbnails against each other to determine which one performs better. Soon, that process will expand to entire videos. By A/B testing multiple cuts of the same clip, creators can identify the version that best resonates with their audience. AI suggestions delivered by Google’s Gemini models are saving time for users while turning YouTube into a more targeted experience. For social shoppers, an expanded Ask YouTube feature will turn questions and follow-ups into interactive product recommendations that show up across TV and mobile surfaces. At Made On, Mohan officially announced the new Custom Feeds . That tool can turn users’ suggestions into fully populated landing pages that cut across specific content categories. When it comes to TikTok, however, YouTube is borrowing much more than just AI-powered updates. It is leaning into the growing popularity of microdramas by expanding its Series feature . TikTok has found ways to monetize serialized short-form collections , and YouTube is taking a step in that direction with the introduction of Shorts Series . In other words, YouTube homepage shelves will now deliver the granular recommendations Netflix users have come to expect. To make its own Vertical Live streams as functional as their TikTok analogues, YouTube is introducing several new broadcast options. Go Live Together will enable co-hosting on those streams, Live showdowns will turn them into collaborative fundraisers, and Live auto-dubbing will bring streaming content to viewers across the globe. If you think AI-powered personalization is already ubiquitous on YouTube, just wait. Made On YouTube 2026 shows that Mohan and his deputies are paying attention to the formats, features, and products that are shining on other platforms. A lot of that has to do with AI; YouTube, like Spotify, wants to automate audio recommendations, which is why it’s bringing Ask Music — its version of the Spotify DJ — to the YouTube Music app. All of those Vertical Live updates are due to arrive in “early 2027.” From that point on, YouTube has no plans to slow down. Instead, users can expect the flurry of new features to continue. Stay up-to-date with the latest and breaking creator and online video news delivered right to your inbox.
